name: qmake_build
description: Configure and build Qt projects with QMake and make.
whenToUse: When the project uses a .pro file and QMake-based build flow.
When the user needs Qt-oriented build automation from an MCP script tool.
instructions: Treat the project directory as the build anchor and keep the project file relative to that directory.
Use build type and extra qmake or make arguments only when the project requires them.
